title: Minimum Index Sum of Two Lists
summary: Given two arrays of strings, list1 and list2, find all the common strings that have the smallest combined index sum from both lists.
statement: Given two arrays of strings, list1 and list2, find all the common strings that have the smallest combined index sum from both lists. Specifically, for a common string appearing at list1[i] and list2[j], the sum of i + j should be the minimum among all common strings. Return all such common strings, in any order.
constraints: Each list has 1..1,000 unique strings, and at least one string is common.
Return every common string with the smallest combined index sum in any order.
hints: A dictionary turns a matching restaurant into a constant-time lookup.
Scan list1 while tracking the smallest sum seen so far and all ties.
Map list2 strings to indices; for list1 matches replace or append to the answer by sum.
Every common string is examined once, and retaining ties is required because several strings can share the minimum sum.
